vectors.description: A founder-signed 44229 and nothing else is the person's name.
vectors.name: person-name-only

vectors.description: Tiers are ranked, never compared by time: a person's name from t=100 beats a valid generated title from t=200.
vectors.name: older-person-name-beats-newer-title

vectors.description: Within the person tier the greatest (created_at, id) wins; on a tied created_at the lexicographically greater id.
vectors.name: latest-person-name-wins

vectors.description: Within the generated tier the EARLIEST valid title wins, so a title never flips: t=200 beats t=250 (another execution's provider) and t=300.
vectors.name: earliest-title-wins

vectors.description: Two valid titles with the same created_at: the lexicographically smaller id wins.
vectors.name: earliest-title-tie-breaks-on-smaller-id

vectors.description: A title naming execution A1 but signed by B's provider (an umbrella signer, not A1's authority) is ignored and counted, even though it is earlier.
vectors.name: foreign-signer-ignored

vectors.description: A stranger with no execution in the umbrella is ignored and counted, whether its cs-target names an umbrella execution or one outside it; with no valid title the founding execution's title stands.
vectors.name: signer-without-execution-ignored

vectors.description: A's own provider signing for a target the umbrella does not hold is not standing: the exact target key, generation included, must be listed.
vectors.name: target-outside-umbrella-ignored

vectors.description: A title signed for generation 1 still stands when the reader lists generation 2 beside it.
vectors.name: title-survives-a-restart

vectors.description: A 44229 not signed by the founder is never the person's name, however new; it is counted and the generated title shows.
vectors.name: foreign-name-never-a-person-name

vectors.description: Without a known founder no 44229 is a person's name: each is counted foreign and the next tier answers.
vectors.name: founder-unknown

vectors.description: Nothing names the session: the founding execution's title.
vectors.name: fallback-founding-execution-title

vectors.description: A blank founding execution title is no title: "Untitled session".
vectors.name: fallback-blank-founding-title

vectors.description: Events for another sessionRef or another channel, and other kinds, are not this session's and are not counted.

events.content: A goal is not a name

vectors.name: other-sessions-ignored

vectors.description: Every malformed 44229/44252 carrying this session's exact h and d is rejected and counted; none of them names the session. (The uppercase-d envelope vector is absent here: it does not carry this session's d, so it is not this session's event at all.)
vectors.name: malformed-events-rejected
